title.tr: Cumartesi pazarı: çoğul, sayılar, «ne kadar?» ve δίνω
title.en: Saturday at the street market: plurals, numbers, «how much?» and δίνω

blocks.tr:
Bu bölümde laiki pazarında ve süpermarkette alışveriş yapmayı öğreneceksin: kaç kilo, kaç tane istediğini söylemek, fiyatı sormak, parayı vermek.

Anahtar nokta: Türkçede çoğul tek bir ekle yapılır (*-ler/-lar*) ve sayıdan sonra isim tekil kalır (*üç domates*). Yunancada **artikel de isim de** değişir ve birden büyük bir sayıdan sonra isim **çoğuldur**: **τρεις ντομάτες**.
blocks.en:
In this chapter you learn to shop at the laiki street market and the supermarket: how many kilos or pieces, the price, paying.

The key point: in the plural **both the article and the noun** change, and after any number above one the noun is **plural**: **τρεις ντομάτες**.

blocks.tr: Dinle, sonra oku. *Πόσο [[κάνουν]];* şimdilik bir kalıp: Ders 7'deki *Πόσο κάνει;* sorusunun çoğulu. Yeni biçimler: [[κιλά]] (kilolar), [[αυγά]] (yumurtalar), [[έχεις]] (sende var), [[εκεί]] (orada), [[όλα μαζί]] (hepsi birlikte).
blocks.en: Listen, then read. *Πόσο [[κάνουν]];* («how much are they?») is a set phrase for now, the plural of Lesson 7's *Πόσο κάνει;*. New forms: [[κιλά]] (kilos), [[αυγά]] (eggs), [[έχεις]] (you have), [[εκεί]] (there), [[όλα μαζί]] (all together).

setting.tr: Cumartesi sabahı, Kallithea'daki laiki pazarında: Ayşe, manav [[ο μανάβης]] Kostas'ın tezgâhında.
setting.en: Saturday morning at the laiki in Kallithea: Ayşe at the stall of Kostas, a greengrocer ([[ο μανάβης]]).

lines.el: Καλημέρα σας. Πόσο κάνουν οι ντομάτες;
lines.en: Good morning. How much are the tomatoes?

lines.el: Δύο ευρώ το κιλό. Οι πιπεριές κάνουν τρία.
lines.en: Two euros a kilo. The peppers are three.

lines.el: Θα ήθελα δύο κιλά ντομάτες και τέσσερις πιπεριές.
lines.tr: İki kilo domates ve dört biber istiyorum.
lines.en: I'd like two kilos of tomatoes and four peppers.

lines.el: Ορίστε. Θέλετε και φράουλες; Τέσσερα ευρώ το κιλό, πολύ φρέσκες!
lines.tr: Buyurun. Çilek de ister misiniz? Kilosu dört euro, çok taze!
lines.en: Here you are. Would you like strawberries too? Four euros a kilo, very fresh!

lines.el: Και αγγούρια; Αυτά εδώ κάνουν ένα ευρώ το κιλό, εκείνα εκεί δύο.
lines.tr: Salatalık da? Bunlar kilosu bir euro, şuradakiler iki.
lines.en: And cucumbers? These here are one euro a kilo, those over there two.

lines.el: Ευχαριστώ! Ορίστε ένα ευρώ. Γεια σας!
lines.tr: Teşekkürler! Buyurun, bir euro. Hoşça kalın!
lines.en: Thank you! Here is a euro. Goodbye!

setting.tr: Pazardan sonra süpermarkette: Ayşe ve arkadaşı Eleni eksikleri alıyor.
setting.en: After the market, in the supermarket: Ayşe and her friend Eleni buy what is missing.

lines.el: Έχεις πολλά πράγματα! Πόσα έδωσες στη λαϊκή;
lines.tr: Ne çok şey almışsın! Pazarda kaç para verdin?
lines.en: You've got a lot of things! How much did you pay at the laiki?

lines.el: Έδωσα εννιά ευρώ. Τώρα έχω αρκετές ντομάτες, αλλά δεν έχω καθόλου ρύζι. Θέλω ένα πακέτο ρύζι και δύο μπουκάλια νερό.
lines.tr: Dokuz euro verdim. Artık yeterince domatesim var, ama hiç pirincim yok. Bir paket pirinç ve iki şişe su istiyorum.
lines.en: I paid nine euros. Now I have enough tomatoes, but I have no rice at all. I want a packet of rice and two bottles of water.

lines.el: Εγώ δεν έχω κανένα αυγό. Θέλω έξι αυγά και λίγο τυρί.
lines.tr: Benim hiç yumurtam yok. Altı yumurta ve biraz peynir istiyorum.
lines.en: I don't have a single egg. I want six eggs and a little cheese.

lines.el: Δεκατρία ευρώ και δεκατέσσερα λεπτά, παρακαλώ.
lines.tr: On üç euro on dört sent, lütfen.
lines.en: Thirteen euros and fourteen cents, please.

title.en: The plural: οι ντομάτες, τα μήλα

blocks.tr: Çoğulda **hem artikel hem isim sonu** değişir. Artikel eril ve dişil için **οι**, nötr için **τα** olur. Kelimeyi hep artikeliyle öğren: artikel ve son birlikte çoğulu gösterir.
blocks.en: In the plural **both the article and the noun ending** change. The article is **οι** for masculine and feminine, **τα** for neuter. Learn each word with its article: the two together tell you the plural.

note.tr: Vurgu genelde yerinde kalır (*πιπεριά → πιπεριές*, *πράγμα → πράγματα*). Ama Yunancada vurgu sondan üçüncü heceden daha geriye gidemez. *-ματα* bir hece eklediği için vurgu bir hece ileri kayar: *μά-θη-μα → μα-θή-μα-τα*, *ό-νο-μα → ο-νό-μα-τα*. Vurgusu son *-ί* üzerinde olan nötrlerde vurgu yeni *α*'ya geçer: *τυρί → τυριά*. Ölçüler: *το κιλό → τα κιλά*.
note.en: The stress mostly stays put (*πιπεριά → πιπεριές*, *πράγμα → πράγματα*). But in Greek the stress can never go back further than the third syllable from the end. *-ματα* adds a syllable, so the stress moves one syllable on: *μά-θη-μα → μα-θή-μα-τα*, *ό-νο-μα → ο-νό-μα-τα*. For neuter nouns stressed on a final *-ί*, the accent goes to the new *α*: *τυρί → τυριά*. Measures: *το κιλό → τα κιλά*.

items.en: The tomatoes are on the stall.

title.tr: Nesne olarak çoğul: τους, τις, τα
title.en: The plural as an object: τους, τις, τα

blocks.tr: Nesne olunca (Ders 7'deki -i hâli, *αιτιατική*) çoğulda artikel değişir: eril **τους**, dişil **τις**, nötr **τα**. İsimde ise yalnızca **-ος** ile biten eril isimlerin sonu değişir: *-οι → -ους*. Öbür isimler özne çoğuluyla aynı kalır.
blocks.en: As an object (the accusative from Lesson 7), the plural article changes: masculine **τους**, feminine **τις**, neuter **τα**. The noun changes only for masculine nouns in **-ος**: *-οι → -ους*. All other nouns stay the same as the subject plural.

note.tr: Vurgusu sondan üçüncü hecede olan bazı *-ος* isimlerinde vurgu *-ους* ile bir hece ileri kayar: *ο δάσκαλος → τους δασκάλους*. Çoğulda -ν kuralı yoktur. Artikeller *σε* ile birleşir: *στους, στις, στα*.
note.en: In some *-ος* nouns stressed on the third syllable from the end, the stress moves one syllable on with *-ους*: *ο δάσκαλος → τους δασκάλους*. There is no -ν rule in the plural. The articles join *σε*: *στους, στις, στα*.

items.el: Ο Κώστας έχει δύο πάγκους στη λαϊκή.
items.en: Kostas has two stalls at the street market.

items.el: Θέλω τις πιπεριές και τα αγγούρια.
items.en: I want the peppers and the cucumbers.

title.tr: Sayılar isme uyar: ένας, μία, ένα; τρεις, τρία
title.en: Numbers that agree: ένας, μία, ένα; τρεις, τρία

blocks.tr: Birkaç sayı ismin cinsiyetine uyar: **1, 3, 4, 13, 14** ve bunlarla biten **21, 23, 24…** (yüzlükler Ders 4'te). Ötekiler değişmez: *δύο, πέντε, έξι … δώδεκα, δεκαπέντε, είκοσι*. Birden büyük bir sayıdan sonra isim **çoğul** olur. Ağırlık Türkçedeki gibi söylenir, ama ölçü de çoğul olur: *iki kilo domates* = **δύο κιλά ντομάτες**, *yarım kilo çilek* = **μισό κιλό φράουλες**.
blocks.en: A few numbers agree with the gender of the noun: **1, 3, 4, 13, 14**, and the numbers ending in them, **21, 23, 24 …** (the hundreds are in Lesson 4). The others never change: *δύο, πέντε, έξι … δώδεκα, δεκαπέντε, είκοσι*. After any number above one the noun is **plural**. For weights there is no «of»: **δύο κιλά ντομάτες**, **μισό κιλό φράουλες**.

note.tr: Bu biçimler nesne olunca da aynı kalır; yalnızca *ένας* → *έναν* olur (Ders 7). Artikel olarak («bir») genellikle *μια* yazılır; *μία* sayıyı vurgular.
note.en: These forms stay the same as an object; only *ένας* becomes *έναν* (Lesson 7). As the article «a», *μια* is the usual spelling; *μία* stresses «one».

items.el: Θέλω τρεις ντομάτες και τρία αγγούρια.
items.tr: Üç domates ve üç salatalık istiyorum.
items.en: I want three tomatoes and three cucumbers.

note.tr: Aynı sayı, iki biçim: *ντομάτες* dişil, *αγγούρια* nötr.
note.en: One number, two forms: *ντομάτες* is feminine, *αγγούρια* neuter.

items.el: Η Ελένη έχει μία αδελφή και τρία παιδιά.
items.tr: Eleni'nin bir kız kardeşi ve üç çocuğu var.
items.en: Eleni has one sister and three children.

note.en: *Παιδί → παιδιά*: the accent goes to the new *α*.

title.tr: Ne kadar? Kaç tane? πόσο, πόσα, πόσες
title.en: How much? How many? πόσο, πόσα, πόσες

blocks.tr: **Πόσος** («ne kadar? kaç tane?») de ismin cinsiyetine ve sayısına uyar. Sayılamayan şey için tekil kullanılır: *πόσο ρύζι;* Sayılabilen şey için çoğul: *πόσα κιλά; πόσες ντομάτες;* Tabloda nesne (-i hâli) biçimleri var.
blocks.en: **Πόσος** («how much? how many?») also agrees with the noun. It is singular for what you do not count: *πόσο ρύζι;* It is plural for what you count: *πόσα κιλά; πόσες ντομάτες;* The table shows the accusative forms.

note.tr: Fiyat sorarken *πόσο* değişmez: *Πόσο κάνει; Πόσο κάνουν οι φράουλες;* Ödenen para için ise *πόσα* duyarsın (*πόσα ευρώ*): *Πόσα έδωσες;*
note.en: When you ask a price, *πόσο* does not change: *Πόσο κάνει; Πόσο κάνουν οι φράουλες;* For money paid you hear *πόσα* (*πόσα ευρώ*): *Πόσα έδωσες;*

items.en: How many kilos of tomatoes do you want?
How much rice do you have?
How many customers do you have today?

title.tr: Çok, az, yeterli, hiç: πολύς, λίγος, αρκετός, κανένας
title.en: A lot, a little, enough, none: πολύς, λίγος, αρκετός, κανένας

blocks.tr: Bu sözcükler sıfat gibi isme uyar ve isimden önce gelir. **Λίγος** («az, biraz») ve **αρκετός** («yeterli, epey») Ders 8'deki *-ος, -η, -ο* sıfatları gibi çekilir: *λίγο τυρί, λίγα αυγά; αρκετούς πελάτες, αρκετές ντομάτες*. Tabloda yalnızca kurala uymayan **πολύς** ve **κανένας** var, nesne biçimleriyle. **Κανένας** («hiçbir») tekildir ve **δεν** ile gelir: *δεν έχω κανένα αυγό*; soruda «hiç» demektir: *Έχεις κανένα αυγό;* **Καθόλου** («hiç») asla değişmez: *δεν έχω καθόλου ρύζι*.
blocks.en: These words agree with the noun and stand before it. **Λίγος** («a little, few») and **αρκετός** («enough, quite a lot») go like Lesson 8's *-ος, -η, -ο* adjectives: *λίγο τυρί, λίγα αυγά, αρκετές ντομάτες*. The table shows the two irregular ones, **πολύς** and **κανένας**, as objects. **Κανένας** («no, not any») is singular and goes with **δεν**: *δεν έχω κανένα αυγό*; in a question it means «any»: *Έχεις κανένα αυγό;* **Καθόλου** («at all») never changes: *δεν έχω καθόλου ρύζι*.

note.tr: Dişil *πολλή* iki λ ile yazılır. *Πολύ* aynı zamanda bildiğin «çok» zarfıdır: *Χαίρω πολύ*. *Καμία* ayrıca *καμιά* diye yazılır.
note.en: Feminine *πολλή* has two λ. *Πολύ* is also the adverb «very, a lot» you know from *Χαίρω πολύ*. *Καμία* is also written *καμιά*.

items.el: Θέλω λίγο τυρί και πολλές φράουλες.
items.tr: Biraz peynir ve bol çilek istiyorum.
items.en: I want a little cheese and a lot of strawberries.

items.el: Δεν έχω κανένα αυγό και καθόλου γάλα.
items.tr: Hiç yumurtam ve hiç sütüm yok.
items.en: I don't have a single egg, and no milk at all.

title.tr: Vermek, ödemek: δίνω, έδωσα, θα δώσω
title.en: Giving and paying: δίνω, έδωσα, θα δώσω

blocks.tr: **Δίνω** «vermek» demektir; bir miktar parayla «ödemek» de olur: *Πόσα έδωσες;* «Kaç para verdin?». Asıl «ödemek» fiili *πληρώνω*'dur (Ders 10): *Σήμερα πληρώνω εγώ.* Geçmiş ve gelecek, Ders 7'deki *πήγα, θα πάω* gibi hazır biçimlerdir, şimdilik yalnızca **ben** ve **sen** için. İkisi de *δωσ-* kökünü kullanır: geçmişte başa *έ-* gelir (*έδωσα*), gelecek **θα** + *δώσω*.
blocks.en: **Δίνω** means «I give»; with an amount of money, «I pay»: *Πόσα έδωσες;* «How much did you pay?». The usual verb for «pay» is *πληρώνω* (Lesson 10): *Σήμερα πληρώνω εγώ.* The past and future are ready-made forms, like Lesson 7's *πήγα, θα πάω*, for now only for **I** and **you**. Both use the stem *δωσ-*: the past adds *έ-* (*έδωσα*), the future is **θα** + *δώσω*.

items.el: Χθες έδωσα είκοσι ευρώ στη Μαρία.
items.en: Yesterday I gave Maria twenty euros.

items.el: Θα δώσεις τις φράουλες στην Ελένη;
items.en: Will you give the strawberries to Eleni?

title.tr: Bu ve şu: αυτός, εκείνος, tekil ve çoğul
title.en: This and that: αυτός and εκείνος, singular and plural

blocks.tr: **Αυτός** «bu» (yakındaki), **εκείνος** «şu, o» (uzaktaki) demektir. İsimle birlikte **artikel yine kalır**: *αυτά τα μήλα*. Tekil *αυτός* biçimlerini Ders 7'de gördün. Çoğul *αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά* ise Ders 2'deki «onlar» ile aynı sözcükler.
blocks.en: **Αυτός** means «this» (near), **εκείνος** «that» (further away). With a noun the **article stays**: *αυτά τα μήλα*. You know singular *αυτός* from Lesson 7; the plural *αυτοί, αυτές, αυτά* are Lesson 2's words for «they».

note.tr: *Αυτός* aynı ekleri alır: *αυτοί οι πάγκοι, αυτούς τους πάγκους, αυτές τις ντομάτες, αυτά τα μήλα*. Dişil nesne *αυτήν την*, *εκείνην την* diye de yazılır.
note.en: *Αυτός* takes the same endings: *αυτοί οι πάγκοι, αυτούς τους πάγκους, αυτές τις ντομάτες, αυτά τα μήλα*. The feminine object is also written *αυτήν την*, *εκείνην την*.

items.el: Αυτά τα αγγούρια κάνουν ένα ευρώ, εκείνα δύο.
items.tr: Bu salatalıklar bir euro, şunlar iki.
items.en: These cucumbers cost one euro, those two.

blocks.tr: Bu dersin kelimeleri: pazar ve süpermarket ürünleri, *δίνω* ve miktar sözcükleri. Bölümü bitirince oturumlarına gelecekler.
blocks.en: This lesson's words: market goods, *δίνω* and the words for amounts. They come into your sessions once you finish the chapter.

blocks.tr: **Tabloya uymayan sık kelimeler.** *Ο καφές* → *οι **καφέδες***, *η πόλη* → *οι **πόλεις***. Türkçeden gelen *ο μανάβης* da *-ηδες* alır: *οι **μανάβηδες***. Bunları çoğuluyla birlikte öğren.
blocks.en: **Common words that break the table.** *Ο καφές* → *οι **καφέδες***, *η πόλη* → *οι **πόλεις***. *Ο μανάβης*, a word from Turkish, takes *-ηδες*: *οι **μανάβηδες***. Learn these with their plural.

blocks.tr: **«Hiç» için olumsuz fiil gerekir.** *Έχω κανένα αυγό* denmez; Türkçedeki *hiç yumurtam yok* gibi fiil olumsuz olmalı: **δεν** έχω κανένα αυγό, **δεν** έχω καθόλου γάλα.
blocks.en: **«None» needs a negative verb:** **δεν** έχω κανένα αυγό, **δεν** έχω καθόλου γάλα. *Έχω κανένα αυγό* is wrong.

blocks.tr: Şimdi sen dene: çoğul, sayıların uyumu ve δίνω.
blocks.en: Now you try: the plural, numbers that agree, and δίνω.
